audit.framing_9x16: Full vertical 9:16 crop of custom Source Filmmaker 3D animation, centering characters and monsters dynamically to ensure complete visual clarity.
audit.subtitle_craft: Bold white sans-serif uppercase typography centered on screen, word-by-word highlighting or single-line pacing synchronized precisely to voice delivery, with emphasis scaling on comedic beats.
audit.zoom_and_camera_work: Purposeful animated virtual camera framing, pushing in on character gestures and panning to reveal monsters approaching in the background for comedic timing.
audit.sfx_and_music_craft: Minimalist sound design relying on crisp in-game audio cues, impact thuds for physical hits, and sudden deadpan pauses to emphasize the comedic absurdity of negotiating with monsters.
audit.comedic_timing_and_cuts: Immaculate comedic timing structured around deadpan dialogue delivery, escalating absurdity from insect neurons to billion-neuron humans, and abrupt punchline cuts.
standout_techniques: Using custom 3D animated machinima to recreate improvised multiplayer voice chat moments
Precise word-level subtitle pacing that mirrors the cadence of deadpan delivery
Visual comedic reveals by panning the camera to show dangerous monsters creeping up behind oblivious characters
Punctuation of dialogue beats with sudden physical actions and sound effects
anti_patterns_to_avoid: Relying on cluttered multiple facecam overlays that distract from the main action
Overusing obnoxious meme sound effects that drown out witty dialogue
